title: OAS lockfile (oas-lock.json)
description: Scope-local lockfile. lockfileVersion 2 locks whole distribution packages (exact commit + integrity); lockfileVersion 1 is the legacy per-capability marketplace lock, still readable for migration only. A lock never advances silently on restore.

packages.description: Map of package identity → exact lock entry for the full dependency closure at this scope.

source.description: Normalized acquisition source, in EXACTLY the writer's grammar: git:<url>@<ref>, path:<absolute-dir>, catalog:<id> for an originally bare catalog request, or catalog:<id>@<selector> for an originally explicit selector (the resolved commit is separate; official catalog identity grants no executable trust). It never carries a "#<path>" fragment — the selected package root is the entry's own "path" field. Parsed strictly: a payload that merely starts with a known scheme but is not valid for that kind (catalog:../evil, path:relative/dir) is an invalid lock, because update re-derives a source spec from this string and would reclassify it.

path.description: Canonical, repository-relative path of the SELECTED package root inside the source (the directory carrying oas-package.json). "." is the canonical spelling of the source root; git/catalog sources default to "oas-package" when the source contract selects nothing; path: sources are exact directories and always record ".". Never normalized or repaired on read — a non-canonical spelling is an invalid lock. Only `oas update` may change it.

commit.description: Exact git commit the package was acquired at (40-hex). For path: sources this is the string "local".

integrity.description: sha256 tree hash of the installed package root; any change invalidates all capability approvals.

depsIntegrity.description: sha256 digest of the MATERIALIZED runtime dependency closure (every node_modules tree under the package root); absent when the package has no runtime deps. Trust verifies it alongside the source integrity.

capabilities.description: Capability IDs the locked manifest exports. Verification metadata only — must match the locked oas-package.json on restore.

dependencies.description: Package identities of direct dependencies (each present in this lock's packages map).

trustedCapabilities.description: Capability IDs whose executable surfaces (commands/hooks) are approved at exactly this integrity. Subset of capabilities. Reset to [] whenever integrity changes.

capabilities.description: OPTIONAL legacy v1 capability-lock residue retained during staged migration (entries `oas migrate` could not yet map to packages). Same entry shape as lockfileVersion 1; doctor flags them as pending migration.

oneOf.title: lockfileVersion 1 — legacy per-capability marketplace locks (readable for migration only)
